name: opal-clip-cloud
description: Lightweight YouTube video clipper — zero-dependency Node.js server for Render free tier (512MB, 24x7, up to 4K, instant cut with 360p YouTube previews on every clip card, downloads render at click-time from the exact timestamp at the chosen quality — frame-exact H.264 re-encode so clips play instantly with no frozen video at the start, audio-only tracks stay remuxed, 3-layer caching)
